title: User registration, login, logout, and session-based auth
description: The auth blueprint (url_prefix /auth) provides account registration, login, and logout backed by a signed session cookie. Registration validates required username/password, stores a werkzeug-hashed password, and rejects duplicate usernames. Login verifies the hash, clears the session (fixation mitigation) and stores user_id. A before_app_request hook loads the logged-in user into g.user, and a login_required decorator redirects anonymous users to the login page.
spec:
1. Verify flaskr/auth.py defines a Blueprint 'auth' with url_prefix '/auth' registered in create_app.
2. Verify GET/POST /auth/register renders auth/register.html and, on POST, requires username and password, inserts the user with generate_password_hash, flashes 'User {username} is already registered.' on IntegrityError (unique username), and redirects to auth.login on success.
3. Verify GET/POST /auth/login renders auth/login.html, looks up the user, rejects with 'Incorrect username.'/'Incorrect password.' via check_password_hash, and on success calls session.clear() then sets session['user_id'] and redirects to index.
4. Verify GET /auth/logout clears the session and redirects to index.
5. Verify load_logged_in_user (before_app_request) sets g.user from session['user_id'], and login_required redirects anonymous users to auth.login.
6. Verify tests/test_auth.py covers register, login, logout, session population, and login_required.
